description: Teal-green crystal with a wicked point, prised out of a Mosscairn's seams. Holds an edge and a grudge.
lore: The grudge is a shop joke. A hafted jade point keeps its edge past all reason — past the steel beside it on the bench, past the arm using it — and when a cutler cannot explain a thing he gives it a temper instead. So the shards are surly, the good ones are spiteful, and everybody laughs.

An apprentice at the sheds asked, in front of the whole bench, whether a piece off a [[monsters/stone_golem|Mosscairn]] remembers having been part of one. The bench laughed. The master did not. He let it go all afternoon, and then, while the boy was sweeping up, said without turning round that they do not ask that in here, and went back to work.
